The text prints no requirements, total hours, outcomes or careers for this award, so no blocks are recorded.

The OTEC 200 description names it 'Computer Concepts and Applications III', which looks like a catalog typo. The descriptions of OTEC 205 and 206 recommend OTEC 212 for that certificate. These are course-description statements, not program requirements, so they were not recorded as blocks.
The Business Information Worker I requirements are probably on another catalog page, possibly under Computers. A reviewer should check that page.
